headline: GIFT Nifty signals muted start amid geopolitical risk premium and surging crude oil prices at $106

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: GIFT Nifty indicates a tepid and muted opening for Sensex and Nifty 50 on September 28.
Crude oil prices rose to $106 after Trump rejected an Iran deal, stoking geopolitical risk premiums.
Global cues remain weak as South Korea's Kospi dropped 2% on escalating US-Iran tensions.
Market capitalization faced heavy erosion recently with nearly 40% of Nifty stocks down over 20% from their 52-week highs.
whatHappening: SRIT India IPO opens today for subscription with GMP indicating a 12% premium.
Three SME IPOs—Robokidz, FX Multitech, and Vivekanand Cotspin—are set to list on the exchanges today.
Adroit Industries IPO allotment status and share allocation key details are being finalized.
Four new SME IPOs are opening for subscription today across various price bands and lot sizes.
summary:
Indian markets face a muted opening on September 28 according to GIFT Nifty cues amid rising global geopolitical tensions.
Crude oil prices surged to $106 per barrel following US-Iran tensions and talk of a US diesel export ban.
Primary market momentum remains strong with several SME IPO listings, fresh IPO subscription opens, and allotment updates.
